name: Mortality Wanes
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I have not long to live... so... so... weak.

...the b-b-brave dwarf, Lonebrow, has been sent to w-w-warn Falfindel...

But before I... d-d-die...

...my wife, Treshala... her pendant of bonding to me... stolen... by one of the f-f-foul aggressors...

Find it p-p-please... and return it to Treshala in Darnassus...

...along with w-w-word of my lonely... death.
narrative.objectives: Find and return Treshala's Pendant to Treshala Fallowbrook in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText:
No!

'Tis not fair. Oh, cruel and intolerable world!

I must now carry this burden of grief and not let Heralath's work die with him.

You were brave to journey from such a dangerous place, adventurer. But please leave me now.

In solitude I shall mourn.
narrative.requestItemsText: What brings you to my home, friend?

objectiveItems.name: Treshala's Pendant
sources: Charlga Razorflank 10% in Razorfen Kraul and 4 more
